d: Job Title: Senior Generator Technician - TS/SCI
Job Category: Engineering and Technical Support
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: TS/SCI
Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 25%
CACI is seeking a Sr. Generator Technician to support our mission critical program in Kuwait.

As the selected Senior Generator Technician, you will, in part, perform preventative maintenance, load bank, field diagnosis and repairs on 50kW ~ 2500kW stand alone and paralleling generators and automatic transfer switches. You will also be responsible for the diagnosis and repair of related electrical components: paralleling switchgear, automatic transfer switches, distribution gear, transformers, service panels, voltage regulators, troubleshooting AC and DC circuits.
q: Bachelors Degree plus 3 years experience or High School Diploma or equivalent and a power generation certification with a 10 years of experience in power generation operations; or 12 years’ Military experience in power generation operations.
Technical understanding of power generation operation and maintenance, certification from power generation manufacturer preferred.
Knowledge of document and report writing.
Knowledge of safe work practices and Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
Knowledge of lockout and tag out procedures.
Ability to effectively communicate, speak and write.
US Citizen with an active TS/SCI clearance is required.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.
Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

r: Operate and maintain auxiliary generator equipment’s to include fuel systems.
Oils, greases and adjusts machinery and equipment and makes minor repairs.
Make periodic inspections to see that all equipment and controls are operating properly and are in good condition.
Utilize CMMS tools to manage building work orders, maintenance, repairs and spare part inventory.
Maintains inventory lists and requisitions supplies, materials and repair parts.
Maintain proper housekeeping of tools and power generation equipment.
Perform various types and levels of repair on single-phase uninterruptible power supplies (UPS), including identifying overload conditions, battery replacement, and system replacement/installation.
Troubleshoot at the paralleling switchgears and control panels to include PLCs.
